id.description: The MR/PR number if one is known from context (e.g. '!418'). Null if there is none — never invent one.

title.description: A short, human headline for this change (not a commit message).

source_branch.description: The branch being reviewed, from `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`.

target_branch.description: The base branch this is being compared against.

base_sha.description: The merge-base commit, from `git merge-base <target_branch> HEAD`.

head_sha.description: The commit being reviewed, from `git rev-parse HEAD`.

what.description: A plain-language narrative of what changed, without quoting code.

why.description: The problem or goal this change addresses.

risks.description: The main risk or trade-off a reviewer should keep in mind overall. Say so explicitly if there isn't one.

out_of_scope.description: What this change deliberately does not touch, to set the reviewer's expectations. Say so explicitly if nothing notable is out of scope.

estimated_reading_minutes.description: A rough estimate of how long a careful reviewer would take to read this report.

id.description: A short, stable, kebab-case slug for this step (e.g. 'invalidation').

kind.description: foundation: data/schema/contracts this step's logic depends on. core: the main logic. wiring: integrating that logic with its callers. delicate: a step that carries real risk and deserves the closest reading. tests: test coverage.

role.description: This step's role in the overall change, in one short phrase, e.g. 'Defines the interface the cache must satisfy'.

intro.description: A short (1-2 sentence) teaser: what this step does and why it comes at this point in the story.

detail.description: The fuller reviewer-facing explanation: why this change was made this way.

path.description: Repo-relative path of a file touched in this step, exactly as it appears in the diff.

why.description: Why this specific file changed this way, explained to a reviewer.

watchpoints.description: Things worth double-checking in this specific file. Omit or leave empty if there are none.

confidence.description: How confident you are that this file's role is understood correctly, e.g. because its callers or tests weren't visible.

index.description: 0-based position of this hunk among this file's hunks, in the order they appear in `git diff`.

label.description: Short label for the hunk, e.g. a function name it falls in — the text after the second '@@' in the hunk header, if present.

note.description: Optional short note about this specific hunk.

focus_lines.description: New-file line numbers within this hunk that most deserve the reviewer's eye. Omit if the whole hunk is equally relevant.
